newsitem.title: USA: U.S. names 14 new historic landmarks.
newsitem.headline: U.S. names 14 new historic landmarks.

text.p: U.S. Interior Secretary Bruce Babbitt Tuesday named 14 properties across the country as new historic landmarks.
Following is a list of the new landmarks:
- Grand Canyon Village in Grand Canyon National Park, Arizona
- Philip Johnson's Glass House in New Canaan, Connecticut
- Haymarket Martyrs' Monument in Forest Park, Illinois
- Owen Lovejoy House in Princeton, Illinois
- Eleutherian College classroom and chapel in Lancaster, Indiana
- Spring Hill Ranch in Chase County, Kansas
- Greenbelt Historic District in Greenbelt, Maryland
- Going-to-the-Sun Road in Glacier National Park, Montana
- Huff archaeological site in Morgan County, North Dakota
- John P. Parker House in Ripley, Ohio
- John Rankin House in Ripley, Ohio
- Vanderbilt archaeological site in Campbell County, South Dakota
- Mount Rainier National Park in Mount Rainier, Washington
- Matewan Historic District in Matewan, West Virginia
